content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Aiken

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's credential handbook to verify you meet the prerequisite hours in both categories. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can clarify whether your background qualifies.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Boot Camp, delivered by certified instructors. Attend all sessions synchronously to satisfy PMI's formal-education requirement. Our structured curriculum covers the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains in real time.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the boot camp, submit your official PMI credential application and pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI. Our team will guide you through the online submission process and verify your documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner and complete it at a test center or approved remote location.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After earning the PMP®, commit to earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses and webinars that count toward your PDU requirement and keep your skills current.
